name: Periglacial-Serac
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by glass plains from an ancient cataclysm and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
the pirate hideout was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
